privacy_policy: Educational IDs, conditions, ordered tokens and opaque complete snapshot hashes only. No raw SQL question rows, timestamps, credentials, runtime identity or progress.

review_summary.null_policy: Preserve the existing absent technical filter. Exclude unselected questions on exact-bound unsaved matching clones, never by writing a level.
review_summary.boundary: Original 36 A2/B1 focus candidates plus one independently reviewed B2 reserve. Four B1 and one B2 question in the negative-word widget; its actual technical NULL filter and full same-bank 72-question pool are unchanged. Other 179 candidates are scope-excluded, not claimed fully semantically reviewed.
review_summary.negatives_coverage_limit: The selected five now include initial None of + mass water without repairing original tokens. The two B1 none keys with internal None remain excluded. Own tasks retain no/none/neither/either coverage; the widget is a finite sample, not every construction.

clone_only_policy: Every original attribute and loaded answer/option/hint/pivot snapshot must match. Only the displayed Ukrainian condition is replaced on clones. Native case and multiplicity remain unchanged. Unknown/stale input fully falls back.

all_eligible_review.native_case_word_key: I need a piece of luggage

all_eligible_review.native_case_word_key: She drank a Glass of juice

all_eligible_review.native_case_word_key: We bought a bottle of water

all_eligible_review.actual_ordered_key: He ate a slice of cheese
all_eligible_review.native_case_word_key: He ate a slice of cheese

all_eligible_review.actual_ordered_key: They Brought a loaf of bread
all_eligible_review.native_case_word_key: They Brought a loaf of bread
all_eligible_review.decision: A loaf of bread is natural and useful, but Brought remains capitalized mid-sentence in the unchanged native case path. Do not alter shared raw token or mask it with a silent case rewrite; own practice retains loaf/loaves elsewhere.

all_eligible_review.actual_ordered_key: I made a bowl of rice
all_eligible_review.native_case_word_key: I made a bowl of rice

all_eligible_review.actual_ordered_key: She opened a can of tomatoes
all_eligible_review.native_case_word_key: She opened a can of tomatoes
all_eligible_review.decision: Natural can-of-tomatoes collocation tests metal packaging plus countable plural contents. Bounded container removes the ambiguity of Ukrainian банка.

all_eligible_review.native_case_word_key: He gave me two cups of coffee

all_eligible_review.native_case_word_key: We discussed three cups of coffee

Initial None of refers to all previously identified water; zero clean water, not merely not all. Mass water takes was. Preserved native tokens avoid the internal no short-answer formatter. One B2 teaching question is explicit; actual NULL technical selection is unchanged.

all_eligible_review.native_case_word_key: The Gobi is very dry

all_eligible_review.native_case_word_key: He moved to the United states
all_eligible_review.decision: Actual ordered token states is lowercase, inconsistent with proper name United States and declared States in options_by_marker; cannot fix by clone-only Ukrainian condition. Source Ukrainian also needs Штатів. Exclude without changing tokens or global questions.

all_eligible_review.actual_ordered_key: They climbed Mount Everest
all_eligible_review.native_case_word_key: They climbed Mount Everest

all_eligible_review.native_case_word_key: We swam in lake Como
